title: Auction Finance UK
summary: Search-result title of the page is 'Auction Finance UK' [a][b]. The page presents auction finance as a short-term bridging loan built around auction deadlines: a 10% deposit is paid on auction day, the remaining 90% must be completed within 28 days, and the loan gives 6 to 12 months to refinance onto a standard mortgage or sell the property for a profit [a][b]. Only two sentences of the page itself surfaced verbatim [b]. Supporting statements come from other site pages surfaced alongside it: /faq/ (terms indication by lunchtime if lot number sent in the morning; indicative terms usually within 1 to 4 hours; lenders lend on value as-is with a clear schedule of works; network of over 800 lenders UK and international) and /bridging-loans-uk/ (completion in as little as 5-14 days subject to lender approval). The search tool states the page does not reveal fees, rates or minimum loan sizes [a]. Search (c) returned no Silver Oak content at all.
